t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Enra mia onanque nocon Dios, min ca jonia iqui mia onanti itan rabite, Enra ohuiquen ramabicon yosma betan min coshi, ea jahuequioma itan mia jahuequiya. Yamaraque huetsa Dios mia quesca, jan noa aquinti onsanconia, mia iqui minbish ja.
